company.name: Justo
company.shortDescription: Justo helps restaurants in Latin America to take online orders directly from their customers and increase their margins.
company.description: Justo is to provide custom-built e-commerce websites for restaurant brands and provide order and delivery for a maximum of 15 percent take — plus the owners get to keep the precious data accrued from the service.

productsAndServices.description: Software for restaurants to manage daily operations including order taking, inventory control, and table management from any device.

productsAndServices.description: A customizable online store platform for restaurants to sell products directly to customers with integrated payment and order tracking.
productsAndServices.name: E-commerce

productsAndServices.description: A system to centralize and manage orders received via phone or social media, integrating them into a single sales and delivery workflow.
productsAndServices.name: Commander

productsAndServices.description: A payment terminal device for restaurants to process multiple types of card payments quickly and securely, integrated with Justo's ecosystem.
productsAndServices.name: Terminal de Pago (Payment Terminal)

productsAndServices.description: A customizable reservation management system that integrates with the point of sale and supports multiple booking channels with automated confirmations.
productsAndServices.name: Reserva (Reservation System)

productsAndServices.description: A delivery management system that integrates with e-commerce platforms to control and track order deliveries with real-time monitoring and API connectivity.
productsAndServices.name: Logística (Logistics)

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $2,300,000, or 90.02% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $480,000 to $13,593,390, a 28.32x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
